deskLvPayS1Sent: Slate S1 sent over Epicbox · waiting for S2

@deskLvPayS1Sent.description: Deep end payment steps: sub-line under the current step 'Recipient signed' of a send over Epicbox whose relay is not known; S1 and S2 are the two slate messages.

@deskLvPayS1On.description: Deep end payment steps: sub-line under the current step 'Recipient signed' of a send over Epicbox; relay is the Epicbox server's address; S1 and S2 are the two slate messages.

@deskLvPayOnEpicbox.description: Payment steps: sub-line under the current step 'Recipient signed' of a send over Epicbox: the payment waits on the Epicbox server for the recipient's wallet. The server's host is in the tooltip. Short.

@deskLvPayNotOpen.description: Shallow payment steps: sub-line under the current step of a send over Epicbox, the recipient has not signed because their wallet is not open; name is the contact.

@deskLvPayWaitingOpen.description: Deeper payment steps: sub-line under the current step of a send over Epicbox, waiting for the recipient's wallet to open and sign; name is the contact.

@deskLvPaySenderFinished.description: Shallow and Deeper payment steps of a payment received: the sender's wallet has finished its part.

@deskLvPayPostedNode.description: Deep end payment steps: the payment was posted to the node.

@deskLvPayConfirmingComma.description: Deeper payment steps: confirmations so far of the number the wallet waits for.

@deskLvPayConfirmationsOf.description: Deep end payment steps: confirmations so far over the number the wallet waits for.

@deskLvPayDone.description: Shallow payment steps: the last step, the payment is finished.

@deskLvPayOnItsWayTo.description: Overview's card for a payment you sent that is not done yet (Shallow and Deeper); name is the contact.

@deskLvPaySendingInPerson.description: Overview's card for a payment you sent in person (a code or a file handed over) that is not done yet (Deep end).

@deskLvPaySendingTo.description: Overview's card for a payment you sent that is not done yet (Deep end); name is the recipient.

@deskLvPayArrivingFrom.description: Overview's card for a payment received that is not done yet; name is the sender.

@deskLvPayStartedAt.description: Overview's card for a payment in progress: its amount and the time it started.

@deskLvPayHeroArriving.description: Overview's hero sentence at Shallow: one payment from a contact is on its way in; amount is the EPIC amount.

@deskLvPayHeroArrivingMany.description: Overview's hero sentence at Shallow: payments are on their way in; amount is their sum.

@deskLvPayHeroHold.description: Overview's hero sentence at Shallow: a payment you sent is waiting for the recipient to sign, its coins are on hold.

@deskLvPayHeroHoldMany.description: Overview's hero sentence at Shallow: payments you sent are waiting to be signed, their coins are on hold; amount is their sum.

@deskLvPayHeroNothing.description: Overview's hero sentence at Shallow in a wallet with no payments.

@deskLvPayReadyTitle.description: Overview notice at Shallow in a wallet with no payments: title.

@deskLvPayReadyHead.description: Overview notice title at Shallow when the new wallet is ready. A title: no period, no "your".

deskLvPayReadyText: Share the address to get the first EPIC.

@deskLvPayReadyText.description: Overview notice at Shallow in a wallet with no payments: text.

@deskLvPayTileConfirming.description: Deeper Overview tile: coins that arrived and wait for more confirmations.

@deskLvPayTileMining.description: Deeper Overview tile: mining rewards that are not yet spendable.

@deskLvPayTileWaiting.description: Deeper Overview tile: payments waiting for the sender to finish.

@deskLvPayTileAwaiting.description: Deeper Overview tile and the small Overview picture at Deeper: payments waiting for the other wallet's reply. Short: fits one line in a narrow tile.

@deskLvPayTileLocked.description: Deeper Overview tile: coins held by payments you sent.

deskLvPayImmatureCasual: Fresh from mining, not spendable yet

@deskLvPayImmatureCasual.description: Deeper row status of a mining reward that is not spendable yet.

@deskLvPayKind.description: Shallow Activity row: the line under a name when the payment has no note.
